messages:
julia_pm: FYI — ACME just pinged about tenant-scoped SSO for their pilot. they want it in MVP or they'll delay the pilot by a quarter. TL;DR: customer-driven ask, moderate engineering effort, high commercial impact.

mike_eng: how big is the engineering lift? rough estimate?

julia_pm: mike — estimate from infra side is ~3 sprints to finish end-to-end (auth flows, provisioning, tests). could be cut down if we scope to OIDC only and skip admin UI.

anne_product: Tradeoff: including it in MVP bumps risk to milestone date. sales impact is real though. we need criteria to decide: revenue at risk vs. velocity hit.

sam_sales: revenue side: ACME pilot is a 6-figure ARR signal if it ships on time. delaying likely kills momentum. they already built integration to our API for other features.

luis_design: if we do a smaller scope, we can ship a CLI/provisioning shim + docs for admins. UI can be v1.

mike_eng: technically okay to do OIDC-only for MVP if product accepts manual provisioning. removes admin UI work; still need vault/KMS review.

anne_product: proposal: two options — (A) MVP: OIDC + manual tenant onboarding (no admin UI), gated by security sign-off and infra readiness — do this and keep milestone. (B) Defer SSO UI to v1 and keep full automated provisioning for v1. Which option preserves launch SLOs?

julia_pm: calling out launch SLOs: feature-complete + e2e tests + docs. option A meets SLOs if infra team can drop UI and we get sec review in sprint. option B definitely meets SLOs but loses ACME pilot.

mike_eng: dev capacity check: if we drop UI we free up ~20% of infra/dev time. but we still need QA and small infra changes. estimate: 2 sprints for A, 0.5 sprints for B (just minor docs).

sam_sales: can we get ACME to accept A (manual onboarding) as a pilot compromise? I'll ask — likely yes if timeline is preserved.

anne_product: decision checklist: 1) commercial sign-off (sam) 2) engineering commit (mike) 3) security/governance (julie?) 4) launch docs (luis) 5) risk heatmap. if all green, go with A.

release-bot: milestone update: "MVP-ship" scheduled 1809994000, current status: at-risk for SSO scope.

julia_pm: sam — ping ACME for explicit acceptance of manual provisioning by EOD. mike — can you confirm infra lead can dedicate sprint slices if we go A?

mike_eng: i'll sync with infra lead. tentative yes but need to swap priorities with caching perf task. i'll confirm by EOD 1809991200.

sam_sales: pinged ACME now. they replied: "manual onboarding acceptable for pilot as long as we have runbook + handoff support." :thumbsup:

anne_product: commercial sign-off = ✅. engineering tentative = pending confirmation. security: @security-team please note: temporary manual provisioning flow will require audit logging and an emergency rollback plan.

julia_pm: great. next steps if engineering confirms: 1) scope doc update (we'll mark SSO as 'OIDC + manual onboarding' for MVP) 2) adjust release plan and risk register 3) ship a runbook for ACME 4) add UI to v1 backlog.

mike_eng: confirmed. we can re-prioritize caching perf to next milestone and deliver A. commit: 2 sprints for infra + QA, will not move MVP date.

luis_design: I'll draft the runbook + minimal onboarding screens (hidden for MVP) and handoff notes.

anne_product: logging decision: record in cutlist that we accepted a scope concession (SSO UI -> v1) in exchange for commercial pilot retention. keep this thread as source of truth.

julia_pm: closing loop: MVP scope updated to include OIDC with manual tenant onboarding for customer pilots. v1 will include admin UI and automated provisioning. thanks team. :tada:
